# Chore Chart Maker

> Free, privacy-first printable tools for parents, teachers, roommates and caregivers. Charts are made in the browser: names and chores never leave the device, and there are no accounts.

<!-- Placeholder: expand with page summaries once the tools and guides are live. -->

## Tools

- [Chore Chart Maker](https://chorechartmaker.com/chore-chart-maker/): make a printable chore chart (Letter or A4)
- [Reward Chart Maker](https://chorechartmaker.com/reward-chart-maker/): make a printable reward chart
- [Roommate Chore Chart](https://chorechartmaker.com/roommate-chore-chart/)
- [Morning Routine Chart](https://chorechartmaker.com/morning-routine-chart/)
- [Family Chore Chart](https://chorechartmaker.com/family-chore-chart/)
